knowledgeAnswers.rationale: If the staffing in the contract costs more hours than the price covers, every job under it loses hourly rate.
Escalation clauses and payment terms are part of the sample's contract check sheet.
Client requirements are confirmed in writing before costing, so they can be priced and defended.

practicalCriteria: The learner completes the contract check sheet for a supplied contract and costing, and identifies any staffing or pricing gap.
The learner writes a short note that either approves the price or refers the gap to the head of the business.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and do not sign a contract whose staffing has not been costed or approved.
Stop and refer any contract that requires work the business is not authorised or equipped to do.
